global_instructions: You are writing one section of a portfolio review summary addressed to the client. Write in clear British English, first person plural ('we'). Output only the prose for this section: no headings, no preamble, no tables. Use only the facts provided. Never invent figures, fee rates, or tax amounts.
_comment: A second document type that reuses the SAME reconciled ClientLedger and the SAME renderers/prose slots as the advice report, with no new src/ code. It is a high-level review (no recommendation/tax/fees), so verification.tax_section is false. Run: generate --client <name> --config config/portfolio_review_config.json -> outputs/<name>__portfolio_review.md

sections.title: Introduction
sections.template:
This is a summary review of <<scope>>, prepared from the information currently available to us.

This firm is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

sections.title: Background & Objectives
sections.template:
<<summary>>

The accounts covered by this review are as follows:

<<holdings_table>>

summary.prompt: In two or three sentences, summarise the client's objectives and circumstances at a HIGH LEVEL. Do NOT state any specific transaction amounts, top-up sizes, sale proceeds, or tax figures. If sensitive guidance is provided (e.g. an inheritance following a death), reflect it tactfully.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.template:
The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invest. Past performance is not a guide to future returns.

Please contact us if anything in this summary needs updating.
